motion_blur.setting.enabled.tooltip: Blur what moves on screen. Turned off, the mod does nothing at all.
motion_blur.setting.strength.tooltip: How long the streaks are. 100% is a film camera's half-frame shutter at 60 FPS.
motion_blur.setting.mode.tooltip: Consistent: the same blur at any FPS. Cinematic: like a film camera at your FPS, longer when it is low.
motion_blur.setting.quality.tooltip: Samples per blurred pixel. Higher is smoother on long streaks and costs a little more.
motion_blur.setting.max_length.tooltip: The longest a streak can get, in percent of the screen's height.
motion_blur.setting.moving_objects.toolt: Blur mobs, players and dropped items by their own motion, not only the camera's.
motion_blur.setting.hand.tooltip: Blur the first-person hand and held item as they swing and bob.
